summary: Iteration 4 (both). Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass, including new coverage for connection lifecycle logs (storage_added / storage_updated / storage_deleted), connection_failed logging on POST /api/storages/{id}/test with fake creds (returns {success:false} + non-empty detail), non-blocking check (GET /api/ responds immediately after test call), no-spurious-reconnect on failing list, and static code review of storage_backends.py confirming S3Backend._attempt/_build_client and SambaBackend._attempt/reset_connection_cache with reconnected flag + server.py wiring (_log_reconnect + run_in_threadpool). GET /api/logs is admin-only (non-admin 403, unauth 401), returns entries with keys id/user_email/action/storage_name/storage_type/path/detail/timestamp. Frontend: Logs Activity page shows 4 summary stat cards (Total Events / File Operations / Connection Events / Auto-Reconnects), 3 filter tabs with testids logs-filter-all/file/conn (client-side filtering verified: 'file' hides Connection Failed/Storage Added, 'conn' shows them), logs-table with colored activity badges (Connection Failed, Storage Added, Storage Removed, Storage Updated), user avatar + email, storage name + icon, details, relative time. Refresh button (refresh-logs-button) works. Light theme + Poppins retained. Mobile viewport (390x844) shows no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390) and stat cards reflow to 2x2 grid. Regression: File Browser still lists STAGING S3 / PRODUCTION S3 on desktop and mobile; Storage list page intact. Cleaned up all TEST_ storages I created.
critical_code_review_comments: storage_backends.py SambaBackend._attempt calls self._register() on EVERY attempt (including the first). That's harmless (smbclient.register_session is idempotent for identical creds) but adds a tiny overhead per op. Consider registering lazily and only on retry.

server.py update_storage: when body.type differs from doc['type'], the code encrypts secrets keyed off the NEW body.type but reads existing secret from cfg.get('secret_key' or 'password') using the new type's field, potentially losing the old secret if the type is changed. Edge-case; unlikely in normal UI usage but worth guarding.

server.py _log_reconnect fires only when backend.reconnected is True AFTER a successful op. On a permanent outage the last _attempt raises, so no reconnect log — that is correct behavior (verified by test_no_spurious_reconnect_on_normal_list).
Logs.jsx: relative time is computed once at render; not updated live. Minor UX — refresh button covers it.
seed_data_creation: Only transient TEST_ prefixed storages created during pytest and playwright, all cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids on Logs page: page-title, refresh-logs-button, logs-filter-all/file/conn, logs-table, log-row-{id}. Do NOT touch STAGING S3 / PRODUCTION S3 (real creds). Use ctx.request in playwright for backend API calls in browser automation env — urllib gets 403 from WAF, but Playwright's request context works. Backend pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope (don't change).
